commit.message:
Pin FAAD2 to the SBR-delay flush; build fdkdec on libfaam (#106)

* Pin FAAD2 to a commit that drains the SBR decoder delay

The gapless gate failed on 16 kHz mono LC streams whose tail padding is
under 481 samples, on a clean master as well. FAAD2 2.11.4 runs those
streams through the SBR upsampler and trims its delay from the start, but
never drains it at the end, so the decode ends 481 - padding samples short.

Build FAAD2 from FreewareAdvancedAudio/faad2 287c00c, which adds the
flush (FreewareAdvancedAudio/faad2#16). Frame error and lag are 0 on 82
streams (16 kHz mono and stereo, 20 and 48 kbps); the pinned 2.11.4 was
inexact on 38 of 84.

* Build fdkdec on libfaam and pkg-config libfdk-aac

fdkdec included the frontend's mp4read.c, which no longer exists. Read
MP4 samples and gapless metadata through libfaam instead, free what the
error paths leaked, and find libfdk-aac with pkg-config before falling
back to Homebrew.

- build_fdkdec.sh takes libfaam.a from $FAAC_SRC/build/libfaam (or
  $FAAM_LIB) and rebuilds each time rather than trusting a stale binary
- decodes a 16 kHz LC stream to its exact source length (136091 frames)

 sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y meson ninja-build bc cmake ffmpeg

+# FAAD2 reference decoder: built from the pinned commit into bin/faad. The distro
+# package lags upstream and lacks the gapless MP4 trimming (pinned FAAD2 commit).
 export FAAD_BIN="$(./scripts/build_faad2.sh)"
 
 # Python

@@ -3,19 +3,23 @@
 # Build the reference FAAD2 decoder (faad) for the decoder gate and the
 # conformance reference.
 #
-# Pinned to a release rather than the distro package: the Ubuntu package lags
-# upstream, and 2.11.4 is the first release that trims the encoder delay and the
-# SBR decoder delay from MP4 output using the elst atom and iTunSMPB (gapless),
-# so decodes line up with the source without a search.
+# Pinned to an upstream commit rather than the distro package: the Ubuntu
+# package lags upstream. 2.11.4 is the first release that trims the encoder
+# delay and the SBR decoder delay from MP4 output using the elst atom and
+# iTunSMPB (gapless); the pinned commit also drains the SBR decoder delay at the
+# end of the stream (FreewareAdvancedAudio/faad2#16), without which a stream
+# whose padding is under 481 samples decodes short. Decodes line up with the
+# source without a search.
 #
 # Prints the path of the built binary. Idempotent: reuses bin/faad when it was
 # built from this version.
 #
 
 set -euo pipefail
 
-FAAD2_VERSION="2.11.4"
-FAAD2_SHA256="ee479ccbae4a8387ab696e6f21a481bd83fe3881471cafa81b4ae59d7d3aed43"
+FAAD2_COMMIT="287c00ccf20086db395869cfe8b09fc50a76e988"
+FAAD2_VERSION="2.11.4+${FAAD2_COMMIT:0:7}"
+FAAD2_SHA256="00fd5f6b898377d67d06a751f535669fe14de9bf3f620fb5921b70240608e5ff"
 
 SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
 BENCH_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
@@ -35,7 +39,7 @@ TARBALL="$BUILD_DIR/faad2-$FAAD2_VERSION.tar.gz"
 
 if [[ ! -f "$TARBALL" ]]; then
     echo "==> Downloading FAAD2 $FAAD2_VERSION..." >&2
-    curl -fsSL -o "$TARBALL" "https://github.com/knik0/faad2/archive/refs/tags/$FAAD2_VERSION.tar.gz" >&2
+    curl -fsSL -o "$TARBALL" "https://github.com/FreewareAdvancedAudio/faad2/archive/$FAAD2_COMMIT.tar.gz" >&2
 fi
 
 if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then

@@ -1,11 +1,10 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
 #
-# Build the fdkdec CLI (decodes MP4/M4A or raw ADTS AAC via Homebrew
-# libfdk-aac) for compare_codecs.py.
+# Build the fdkdec CLI (decodes MP4/M4A or raw ADTS AAC via libfdk-aac)
+# for compare_codecs.py.
 #
-# Requires: `brew install fdk-aac` and a FAAC checkout for
-# frontend/mp4read.c (path via $FAAC_SRC, default ../faac next to this
-# faac-benchmark checkout).
+# Requires: libfdk-aac development files and a FAAC checkout (path via
+# $FAAC_SRC, default ../faac next to this faac-benchmark checkout).
 #
 
 set -euo pipefail
@@ -16,42 +15,44 @@ BENCH_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
 BIN_DIR="$BENCH_ROOT/bin"
 TARGET_BIN="$BIN_DIR/fdkdec"
 
-if [[ -x "$TARGET_BIN" ]]; then
-    echo "$TARGET_BIN"
-    exit 0
-fi
-
 FAAC_SRC="${FAAC_SRC:-$BENCH_ROOT/../faac}"
-MP4READ="$FAAC_SRC/frontend/mp4read.c"
-if [[ ! -f "$MP4READ" ]]; then
-    echo "error: mp4read.c not found at $MP4READ (set FAAC_SRC to a faac checkout)" >&2
+if [[ ! -f "$FAAC_SRC/include/faam.h" ]]; then
+    echo "error: faam.h not found under $FAAC_SRC/include (set FAAC_SRC to a faac checkout)" >&2
     exit 1
 fi
 
-# mp4read.c's HAVE_LIBFAAM path calls into libfaam (FAAC's MP4/gapless
-# demuxer) rather than parsing boxes itself; find a built static lib from
-# any of the FAAC checkout's build directories.
+# fdkdec uses FAAM for MP4 sample and gapless metadata. Prefer the standard
+# sibling build, while allowing callers to select another FAAC build with
+# FAAM_LIB.
 FAAM_LIB="${FAAM_LIB:-}"
 if [[ -z "$FAAM_LIB" ]]; then
-    FAAM_LIB="$(find "$FAAC_SRC" -maxdepth 3 -name 'libfaam.a' -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
+    FAAM_LIB="$FAAC_SRC/build/libfaam/libfaam.a"
 fi
 if [[ -z "$FAAM_LIB" || ! -f "$FAAM_LIB" ]]; then
-    echo "error: libfaam.a not found under $FAAC_SRC (build FAAC first, or set FAAM_LIB)" >&2
+    echo "error: libfaam.a not found at $FAAM_LIB (build FAAC in $FAAC_SRC/build, or set FAAM_LIB)" >&2
     exit 1
 fi
 
-FDK_PREFIX="$(brew --prefix fdk-aac 2>/dev/null || echo /opt/homebrew)"
+if pkg-config --exists fdk-aac; then
+    FDK_PREFIX="$(pkg-config --variable=prefix fdk-aac)"
+    read -r -a FDK_CFLAGS <<< "$(pkg-config --cflags fdk-aac)"
+    read -r -a FDK_LIBS <<< "$(pkg-config --libs fdk-aac)"
+else
+    FDK_PREFIX="${FDK_PREFIX:-$(brew --prefix fdk-aac 2>/dev/null || echo /opt/homebrew)}"
+    FDK_CFLAGS=(-I "$FDK_PREFIX/include")
+    FDK_LIBS=(-L "$FDK_PREFIX/lib" -lfdk-aac)
+fi
 if [[ ! -f "$FDK_PREFIX/include/fdk-aac/aacdecoder_lib.h" ]]; then
-    echo "error: libfdk-aac headers not found under $FDK_PREFIX (brew install fdk-aac)" >&2
+    echo "error: libfdk-aac headers not found under $FDK_PREFIX (install libfdk-aac development files)" >&2
     exit 1
 fi
 
 mkdir -p "$BIN_DIR"
 
 echo "==> Compiling fdkdec..." >&2
 gcc -O2 -o "$TARGET_BIN" "$SCRIPT_DIR/fdkdec/fdkdec.c" \
-    -I "$FAAC_SRC/frontend" -I "$FAAC_SRC/include" -I "$FDK_PREFIX/include" \
-    "$FAAM_LIB" -L "$FDK_PREFIX/lib" -lfdk-aac >&2
+    -I "$FAAC_SRC/include" "${FDK_CFLAGS[@]}" \
+    "$FAAM_LIB" "${FDK_LIBS[@]}" >&2
 
 chmod +x "$TARGET_BIN"
 echo "$TARGET_BIN"
